detail.longDescription: A two-week randomised trial with first-year university students found that only those assigned to text a randomly paired peer reported less loneliness at the end. Students assigned to a supportive chatbot called Sam did not differ from the journal group in loneliness reduction, though the AI reduced negative mood. Source: Silicon Canals https:// siliconcanals.com/t-ai-friend- human-peer-loneliness-randomised-study/ # MachineLearning
